resources.string: Keep location active with the screen off and outside the app. Stops after two hours without returning to the app. Track and walk recording are controlled separately.
GPS stays active with the screen off. Background operation can be disabled in location settings.
Battery Saver restricts GPS when the screen is off. Turn it off for continuous location updates.
Android restricts this app’s background operation. Allow unrestricted battery use to keep GPS working with the screen off.
Battery optimization may interrupt GPS with the screen off. Allow this app to work without battery restrictions.
Open the phone’s battery settings and allow unrestricted battery use for this app.
